description: Address 5 review issues: relocate OneSignal init, add tag reconciliation, show station names in dialog, handle dead code, document backend test gap
steps: Create OneSignalProvider component that initializes OneSignal SDK and performs startup tag reconciliation
Update notificationService to store {id, name} tuples instead of plain string IDs and add reconciliation logic
Update NotificationHandler dialog to display station names instead of raw Convex IDs
Update useStationSubscription hook and StationCard to pass station name to subscribeToStation
Add clear documentation comments on getRecentNotification and recordNotification explaining retention for future auth features
Document backend action handler test gap in convex/__tests__/notifications.test.ts
Integrate OneSignalProvider into the app root (layout.tsx or main.tsx)
Update existing tests to match new interfaces (storage format, function signatures)
Run all tests and build to verify everything works
acceptance_criteria: OneSignal.init() is called once at app startup via a provider
Tag reconciliation runs at startup: calls getTags() and syncs with localStorage
NotificationHandler dialog displays station names instead of raw IDs
Storage format is {id, name}[] tuples in localStorage
getRecentNotification and recordNotification have clear documentation comments
Backend test file documents the action handler orchestration test gap
All existing tests pass (updated for new interfaces)
